visualCharacteristics.layout: Full-width bordered table with a shaded header row and alternate row shading; side-by-side places several tables two per row
notable: Short rows span the remaining columns

contentPattern.structure: One block row per table row, one cell per table cell; side-by-side: each one-cell row starts a new table

usage: Use for schedules, results and other tabular data.
reuseGuidance: Fits plain tabular data; the project table block covers tables without a forced header row.
